message.content: The case concerns which bridge incident claims can be logged. Claim A, that the ferry was hull number 29, is contradicted by source S3, which identifies the ferry as hull number 42. Claim C, stating the ferry left the dock at 12:10, is well supported by the dock departure log (S2). Claim B, that the 12:10 ferry crossed before traffic reopened, remains unresolved because the draft dispatch summary (S1) is ambiguous and based on unsynchronized clocks, preventing a clear timeline. Therefore, only Claim C can be confidently published in the log, while Claim A should be rejected and Claim B requires further evidence before inclusion.
